S9-maya-own-account.answer:
The promotion path for a Customer Success Manager (CSM) follows NovaOps' general promotion process [making-a-career.md#Promotion Process]. Promotions happen twice a year, with proposals due in March for April 1 effect and in September for October 1 effect [making-a-career.md#Promotion Process]. 

To advance as a CSM, you need at least six months in your current role, sustained performance, and evidence that you are operating at the next level [making-a-career.md#Promotion Process]. Your manager prepares a packet with evidence of your recent work, peer input, and a mapping to the next title level [making-a-career.md#Promotion Process].

For CSMs, strong evidence includes faster resolution of the right issues, better customer trust, fewer repeat escalations, clearer internal documentation, and product feedback that leads to improvement [titles-for-support.md#Promotion Evidence]. Look for judgment under pressure, not just ticket volume [titles-for-support.md#Promotion Evidence].
